verdict.rationale: GitHub has an official CLI (github-probe-4, cli.github.com), but the evidence pack contains no documentation of AI-native features within that CLI itself (e.g., Copilot integration, agentic commands) — the AI/agent capabilities described elsewhere are tied to Copilot in IDEs/web, not shown as CLI-native. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-native/agentic workflows built into the official CLI, independent hands-on corroboration of CLI's AI capabilities.
